title: 2022 Berkshire Hathaway Annual Meeting
主要内容: At the first in-person Berkshire Hathaway shareholders meeting since 2019, Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger discussed their $40 billion buying spree, an unusual merger arbitrage play, and their dislike of bitcoin as a long-term investment. Berkshire Hathaway's per-share market value soared by 29.6% in 2021, narrowly outperforming the S&P's 28.7% gain. Buffett mentioned that there was little "new or interesting" action at Berkshire Hathaway during the 2022 Annual Meeting, but he and Charlie Munger had made "reasonable progress" in increasing the intrinsic value of the company's shares, in part by repurchasing them.
